build_fmindex_from_sequences: build an FM-index from a collection of integer sequences for efficient text search
create_fmindex_get_doc: create a call to get_doc that retrieves a document by its index from the FM-index
test_fmindex_get_range: test the get_range method to find FM-index rows matching a given token sequence
refactor_fmindex_get_count: refactor the get_count method to count occurrences of a prefix sequence in the index
summarize_fmindex_save_load: summarize the save and load methods for serializing and deserializing the FM-index
